description: Updates an existing intent in a Cognigy.AI flow. MUTATING: This modifies the intent. Use dryRun=true (default) to validate first. After updating, call train_intents to retrain the NLU model.

disambiguationSentence.description: Sentence shown when disambiguating between intents

dryRun.description: If true (default), validates without updating. Set to false to actually update.

flowId.description: The flow ID containing the intent

intentId.description: The ID of the intent to update

name: update_intent
